They usually have a specific outfit or clothing that they wear to hide their identity and protect  (466)  _________  while  fighting  crime.  Superheroes  have been a staple of popular culture (467) ______ decades, appearing in comics,  movies, television shows, and video games.

- Q.464. (a) had explain (b) explain (c) explaining (d) was explain

Childhood  is  an important phase in a person's life. Children are free  from  worries,  tensions  and  stresses  so  they  lead  a  very (493)______  life.  This  is  the only reason they create golden and beautiful memories during this period which are (494)________ in their adulthood. It is the responsibility of parents and guardians to shape the future of a child as he is very (495)________ and can drift in any direction. If they have made any mistakes, we should (496)______  them  instead  of  misbehaving  with  them.  How  we have  behaved  with  them  will  be  (497)________  on  their  minds which will reflect in later stages.
Q.493.
- (a) careful   (b) stressful     (c) cautious   (d) carefree
Q.494.
- (a) blocked  (b) neglected   (c) dumped  (d) cherished
- Q.495. (a) innocent  (b) crafty      (c) mature     (d) guilty
